mapper.select: SELECT id, name, position, photoUrl, bio, career, portfolio, sortOrder, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM staffprofile ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, createdAt ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staffprofile (id, name, position, photoUrl, bio, career, portfolio, sortOrder, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{position}, #{photoUrl}, #{bio}, #{career}, #{portfolio}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE staffprofile SET name=#{name}, position=#{position}, photoUrl=#{photoUrl}, bio=#{bio}, career=#{career}, portfolio=#{portfolio}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE staffprofile SET sortOrder=#{sortOrder}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
